body_part.description: A named preset defining the body region. See [Named Presets](https://0vergrown.github.io/Sync-Documentation-Website/?file=data_types/body_part_modifier_entry) below. If omitted, the region is defined by the explicit coordinate fields instead.
body_part.markdownDescription: A named preset defining the body region. See [Named Presets](https://0vergrown.github.io/Sync-Documentation-Website/?file=data_types/body_part_modifier_entry) below. If omitted, the region is defined by the explicit coordinate fields instead.

x_min.description: Minimum X bound of the region (entity's right side = −1). Ignored when `body_part` is set.
x_min.markdownDescription: Minimum X bound of the region (entity's right side = −1). Ignored when `body_part` is set.

x_max.description: Maximum X bound of the region (entity's left side = +1). Ignored when `body_part` is set.
x_max.markdownDescription: Maximum X bound of the region (entity's left side = +1). Ignored when `body_part` is set.

y_min.description: Minimum Y bound of the region (feet = 0). Ignored when `body_part` is set.
y_min.markdownDescription: Minimum Y bound of the region (feet = 0). Ignored when `body_part` is set.

y_max.description: Maximum Y bound of the region (top of head = 1). Ignored when `body_part` is set.
y_max.markdownDescription: Maximum Y bound of the region (top of head = 1). Ignored when `body_part` is set.

z_min.description: Minimum Z bound of the region (front of entity = −1). Ignored when `body_part` is set.
z_min.markdownDescription: Minimum Z bound of the region (front of entity = −1). Ignored when `body_part` is set.

z_max.description: Maximum Z bound of the region (back of entity = +1). Ignored when `body_part` is set.
z_max.markdownDescription: Maximum Z bound of the region (back of entity = +1). Ignored when `body_part` is set.

modifier.description: A single modifier to apply when the hit falls within this region.
modifier.markdownDescription: A single modifier to apply when the hit falls within this region.

modifiers.description: Multiple modifiers to apply when the hit falls within this region. Applied in order. Can be used together with `modifier`.
modifiers.markdownDescription: Multiple modifiers to apply when the hit falls within this region. Applied in order. Can be used together with `modifier`.

bientity_action.description: If set, this action is executed when this body region is hit. The *_actor_* (first entity) is the attacker; the *_target_* (second entity) is the entity being hit.
bientity_action.markdownDescription: If set, this action is executed when this body region is hit. The *_actor_* (first entity) is the attacker; the *_target_* (second entity) is the entity being hit.
